reason: Phone-call orders are the bulk of my day and I don't believe an app will catch them right without me checking every one. I already keep stock in my head and udhaar in my diary, and it works, so I won't pay 500 a month until I see it put money back in my till.
objection: Will it really catch my phone-call orders correctly without me doing anything? If I have to check and fix every card, it is more work than my diary, and 500 rupees a month is real money for me.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it work on a neighbouring kirana owner's real phone-call orders for a few weeks with hardly any mistakes, and a clear case that it recovers udhaar I would otherwise lose, so it pays for itself.
